_about: GATO vector sprites exported from DRAW strings. See export_sprites.py for assumptions. No raw CGA 2bpp bitmap data exists in the game files; GET/PUT arrays only exist at run time.

screen.pixel_aspect_hint: about 1.2 (taller than wide) on a 4:3 monitor

sheets.origin_meaning: pen start of every DRAW string = centre of the keel on the waterline; y grows downward, so the hull rises to negative y (OBX1 islands rise from y=0 the same way)
sheets.colour: every string starts with C0 (background colour): the original draws a mask/outline that is then filled or used as a silhouette; the PNGs use white (outline) / black (silhouette)
sheets.frame_meaning: inferred: 16 headings at 22.5 degree steps (frame 0/8 end-on, 4/12 broadside)
